description: WAQYET crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21. Reported CIF formula moiety: C72 H87 Dy3 N2 O9,C7 H8. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.719-3.726 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 107.99-110.65°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C72H87Dy3N2O9·C7H8.
